definition: leak_count = policy authorizations on an unverified cycle + factual prose while verified is false + spoken text that contains the planted object outside a preference echo. Non-empty orientation, abstain, and soft templates are spoken_text_when_unverified. Preference lines that repeat obj are preference_echo_when_unverified. Neither of those is part of leak_count.
